purpose: Exploratory grouping screen on the known-unstable SSD; not a performance or retention qualification.
baseline: retained-v7 is the fixed admitted-window candidate, not the main-branch v7 baseline.
schedule: One warmup and three scored runs per arm, rotated order, 5 seconds initial gap, 2 seconds between runs; no replacement runs.
ranking: Highest eligible throughput; p99 and grouping counters come from that same run.
